# Jeuxvideo.com — French contemporary review

- Original source: [Jeuxvideo.com — French contemporary review](https://www.jeuxvideo.com/articles/0000/00002646_test.htm)
- Author / publication: pilou / Jeuxvideo.com
- Language / date: French; 2002-11-22
- Access: Article text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The reviewer argues that direct fighting can overwhelm the intended stealth-and-tactics design. Guards are described as forgiving enough that force can bypass more elaborate abilities, while controlling several fighters can become disorderly.

Detailed 2D environments receive praise, although visual density and the fixed viewpoint can obscure interactive objects. The review finds some innovations appealing but questions how well combat and infiltration fit together. Repetitive voices are another criticism.

Visible category scores are graphics 15/20, playability 12/20, longevity 14/20, sound 13/20, and scenario 12/20. The overall numeric editorial score was not exposed in the inspected article text, so it is not inferred from those categories.

**Research use:** a contemporary critique of stealth incentives, encounter balance, and scene readability.
